items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: because Bienvenido Leon, he don't know how to play the maracas, he was a singer

ctx.x: Okay. When did you sing with Nacional?

Nacional? From 1929 to about six months with the Sexteto Nacional, because Bienvenido Leon, he don't know how to play the maracas, he was a singer, beautiful baritone voice, and they need a maraca player because a sextet/is very important instrument. So in account that they saw me playing at the Agabama, because I was replacing Machin, that he went to sing to a private party, with Miguel Zavayas. Ignacio Pineiro saw me playing the maracas, so I went - he told me "I want you to go to the Havana Sport, that was the…
Oh, I see. So the first one then was Nacional.
